reason: run/no-mistakes-required.sh, its shared workflow, test and registry row were already deleted from main by a817e45 (PR #109, merged 2026-11-12, after the 2026-11-10 decision); nothing in gates greps a PR body for the no-mistakes marker any more, so there is no check here to replace. report.md has the evidence.

followups.text: If PR bodies should stop carrying the 'Updates from [git push no-mistakes](...)' marker, change the no-mistakes binary that writes it; if proof of the pipeline is still wanted, have it post a check run from a GitHub App on the head sha and require that check by app id in the caller's ruleset.
followups.acceptance: A PR raised through no-mistakes carries no machine-matched marker in its body, and, if proof is kept, a required App-posted check run on its head sha passes while a hand-raised PR lacks it.
